summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Gentor Resources Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, providing its Notice of Annual and Special Meeting of Shareholders and Management Information Circular. The meeting covers standard agenda items: receiving financial statements, electing directors, reappointing auditors, reapproving the stock option plan, and authorizing a share consolidation (2:1 reverse split). There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private transaction, spin-off, capital return, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. It is an ordinary periodic notification of an annual/special meeting.
